title: atoll guard confirm --json, atoll guard reject --json, and with --dry-run; POST /v1/guards/{id}
description: What a confirm or a reject did (specs.md §15.6), to the guard of kind: deletions, or modifications. done is false, and up_to null, with no guard event of that kind since the last answer. With --dry-run alone, dry_run and paths are there: nothing was written, done is false, and up_to is the time the answer would go up to, null with nothing to answer.

up_to.description: In UTC with nine digits of fraction, or null.

paths.description: With --dry-run alone: what the guard holds as atoll guard list gives it, in byte order, for a guard that stands, and none otherwise. The answer decides what changed up to up_to; what changed after it is still asked about. For modifications, the files the guard counted, as which files wait only a look can tell.
